For a lot of use cases in future patches
column2: we will want to modify the

column1: state of registers part of some same 'group' (e.g. same ref_obj_id). It
won't just be limited to releasing reference state
flag dynamically based on certain actions
Hence
column2: we need a way to easily pass a callback to the function that

column1: iterates over all registers in current bpf_verifier_state in all frames
upto (and including) the curframe.
While in C++ we would be able to easily use a lambda to pass state and
the callback together
column2: sadly we aren't using C++ in the kernel. The next

column1: best thing to avoid defining a function for each case seems like
statement expressions in GNU C. The kernel already uses them heavily
hence they can passed to the macro in the style of a lambda. The
statement expression will then be substituted in the for loop bodies.
Variables __state and __reg are set to current bpf_func_state and reg
for each invocation of the expression inside the passed in verifier
state.
Then
release_reference
use bpf_for_each_reg_in_vstate.
